newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran Revolutionary Guards senior officer dies.
newsitem.headline: Iran Revolutionary Guards senior officer dies.

text.p: A senior officer of Iran's Revolutionary Guards has died from the effects of chemical poisoning sustained during the 1980-1988 war with Iraq, a newspaper said on Monday.
The daily Jomhuri Eslami said Brigadier-General Reza Qaemi, former commander of a guards unit from Tehran, died on Sunday from injuries suffered in an Iraqi chemical bombing during the war.
United Nations inspectors have confirmed Iraq's use of chemical weapons against Iranian soldiers in several locations during the war between the two neighbours.

The Revolutionary Guards is a military force separate from Iran's regular army, navy and air force. It comprises some 120,000 troops, including naval and marine units, according to the International Institute for Strategic Studies.
